verdict.rationale: The Devin API is documented for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, including creating sessions programmatically [docs-7, docs-8]. The docs also describe wiring Devin into CI/CD pipelines to act on static-analysis findings [docs-19], and a local Devin CLI exists that accepts a prompt on invocation [docs-4, docs-5]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a headless/non-interactive CLI mode (e.g., print mode, structured output, exit codes) for shell scripts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted automation.
